verdict.rationale: Devin's docs show non-engineers can delegate tasks via Slack/Teams or tickets (devin-docs-1, devin-docs-4, devin-docs-21) and get autonomous implementation without direct engineering hands-on-keyboard work, which loosely supports a PM-driven workflow. However, there is no evidence of mockup/design-file ingestion (e.g., Figma import or image-to-code) and community reports note limited real-world success rates and scope (devin-comm-2, devin-comm-3, devin-comm-6), casting doubt on reliability for open-ended design-to-code tasks. missing for 10: explicit design/mockup ingestion capability, evidence of end-to-end success without engineering review, independent validation of PM-only workflows.
